integrity: The proof uses the source hierarchy recursion and absorption rules, proves a finite rewrite normal form and a length cutoff, and replays the resulting exhaustive quotient with the bundled standard-library checker.
scientific_limitations: The exact value 37 is proved only for mutual absorption. Many-one and di-many-one quotients may merge these classes. No matching lower bound or general reducibility algorithm is claimed.
title: Thirty-seven absorption classes at the fourth realizability level
